notes: the first isnad ends at Safiyya, who told Ali b. Husayn; it has no matn of its own. The matn follows the second isnad, which ends at Ali b. Husayn, the last link of that route
«زوج النبي» describes Safiyya and is not part of the name; «فقال لصفية بنت حيى» is the Prophet's words inside the story
two isnads for one saying: two groups, no shared tail
